svg.title: The electromagnetic spectrum
svg.desc: The electromagnetic spectrum on a logarithmic frequency axis from 1 hertz to beyond 10 to the 24 hertz, with the matching wavelength and photon energy on a second axis above. Double-headed arrows mark the ranges of radio waves (up to 10 to the 12 hertz, with AM radio, TV, FM radio, and microwaves inside it), infrared, ultraviolet, X rays, and gamma rays. Visible light is a very narrow rainbow band near 5 times 10 to the 14 hertz, between infrared and ultraviolet.
